verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community comment noting that private-repo package storage drops from 2GB to 500MB when downgrading to GitHub Free. That implies GitHub hosts packages, but no first-party documentation describes publishing or consuming packages or container images. missing for 10: first-party docs for a package registry, support for npm/PyPI/Maven and other formats, container image hosting, public vs private package visibility, publish/consume workflows, independent hands-on corroboration.
